introduction_markdown:
Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board, General Certificate of Education Examination, ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2019. Additional Mathematics, Paper 2, subject code 0575. Time allowed: two and a half hours.

Answer ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A and ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. In Sections B and C, ALL QUESTIONS CARRY EQUAL MARKS. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three.

Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory to all candidates, answer all questions). Section B: Mechanics (answer any two questions; if this section is chosen, then Section C may not be chosen). Section C: Statistics and Probability (if this section is chosen, then Section B may not be chosen; answer any two questions).

All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take $g$ as $10\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$.
incertitudes: Section B/C : la consigne imprimee (reponse a deux questions de la Section B OU de la Section C, jamais un melange des trois) n'est pas exprimable par les regles de choix (« parmi 2 sur 3 » par section) ; elle est recopiee en entier dans l'introduction. Chaque question de B et C vaut 17 points imprimes (egalite annoncee par le sujet).

Q11 : points imprimes (i) 2 + 4 + 3 = 9, (ii) 4, (iii) 4 = 17, conformes. Le bas de la page 4 est voile par une trace rouge mais le texte reste lisible. Q11(iii) : « maximum speed of 10 m/s on a level road against a constant resistance of 500 N » : a vitesse maximale, la force motrice egale la resistance (acceleration nulle).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) The forces $\mathbf{F}_1=(3\mathbf{i}-4\mathbf{j})\ \mathrm{N}$, $\mathbf{F}_2=(-5\mathbf{i}+6\mathbf{j})\ \mathrm{N}$, and $\mathbf{F}_3=(4\mathbf{i}+6\mathbf{j})\ \mathrm{N}$ act on a particle of mass $2\ \mathrm{kg}$.

Find:

(a) the resultant of the three forces acting on the particle. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Add the components:

$$
\mathbf R=\mathbf F_1+\mathbf F_2+\mathbf F_3=(3-5+4)\mathbf{i}+(-4+6+6)\mathbf{j}=2\mathbf{i}+8\mathbf{j}
$$

**The resultant is $(2\mathbf{i}+8\mathbf{j})\ \mathrm{N}$.**
themes: resultant of vector forces and equilibrium

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) the magnitude of the acceleration of the particle. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Newton's second law: $\mathbf R=m\mathbf a$, so $\mathbf a=\dfrac{2\mathbf{i}+8\mathbf{j}}{2}=\mathbf{i}+4\mathbf{j}$.

$$
|\mathbf a|=\sqrt{1^2+4^2}=\sqrt{17}\approx4.12
$$

(Equivalently, $|\mathbf R|=\sqrt{4+64}=2\sqrt{17}\approx8.25\ \mathrm N$ and $|\mathbf a|=\dfrac{2\sqrt{17}}{2}$.)

**The magnitude of the acceleration is $\sqrt{17}\approx4.12\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$.**
themes: resultant of vector forces and equilibrium

questions.enonce_markdown:
Given that a fourth force $\mathbf{F}_4=(x\mathbf{i}+y\mathbf{j})\ \mathrm{N}$ is added to the system and the system is at equilibrium,

(c) Find the values of $x$ and $y$. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
At equilibrium the total force is zero: $\mathbf R+\mathbf F_4=\mathbf 0$.

$$
(2+x)\mathbf{i}+(8+y)\mathbf{j}=\mathbf 0\ \Rightarrow\ x=-2,\quad y=-8
$$

**$x=-2$ and $y=-8$** (so $\mathbf F_4=(-2\mathbf{i}-8\mathbf{j})\ \mathrm N$).
themes: resultant of vector forces and equilibrium

questions.enonce_markdown: (ii) A particle $P$ is displaced from the origin, $O$ to a point $A$ with position vector $(-3\mathbf{i}+5\mathbf{j})\ \mathrm{m}$ by a force $(2\mathbf{i}+7\mathbf{j})\ \mathrm{N}$. Find the work done by the force in displacing the particle from $O$ to $A$. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Work done by a constant force is the scalar product of the force and the displacement. The displacement is $\overrightarrow{OA}=-3\mathbf{i}+5\mathbf{j}$.

$$
W=\mathbf F\cdot\mathbf d=(2)(-3)+(7)(5)=-6+35=29
$$

**The work done is $29\ \mathrm J$.**
themes: work done by a constant vector force

questions.enonce_markdown: (iii) A car is moving at a maximum speed of $10\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ on a level road against a constant resistance of $500\ \mathrm N$. Find the power generated by the engine. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
At maximum speed the acceleration is zero, so the driving force $F$ of the engine equals the resistance: $F=500\ \mathrm N$.

$$
P=Fv=500\times10=5000\ \mathrm W
$$

**The power generated by the engine is $5000\ \mathrm W=5\ \mathrm{kW}$.**
themes: power of a vehicle at maximum speed
